zone.unsupported: Hornwatch is idle outside Occult Crescent.
zone.unsupportedHint: Enter South Horn or North Horn and this window fills in on its own.
watch.emptyHint: Critical encounters and FATEs appear here the moment they spawn.
party.alone: You are not in a party.
party.remoteUnsupported: The game never sends other players' phantom job levels to the client, so that column can only be filled in for you.
jobs.noData: Phantom job data is only readable inside Occult Crescent.
guide.blueMage.title: Phantom Blue Mage
guide.blueMage.intro: Like the limited Blue Mage, phantom Blue Mage learns almost every spell from a specific enemy rather than from levelling. This page is a guide, not a tracker: the game does not tell plugins which spells you already know, so nothing here is ticked off automatically.
guide.blueMage.replacesPrevious: Replaces the previous rank once learned.
guide.blueMage.requiresAeroII: Requires Occult Aero II to have been learned first.
nav.reason.notInstalled: Auto-travel needs the vnavmesh plugin, which is not installed.
nav.reason.meshBuilding: vnavmesh is still building the navigation mesh for this zone.
nav.reason.disabledInSettings: Auto-travel is switched off in the settings.
nav.warningTitle: Auto-travel can get your account actioned
nav.warningBody: Moving your character automatically is exactly what Square Enix's terms forbid, and it is detectable. Nobody can promise you otherwise. Turn this on only if you accept that risk yourself, and use it sparingly and sensibly.
nav.warningAccept: I understand the risk and accept it
nav.warningShort: Detectable - can result in a ban. Use responsibly.
config.developerModeHint: Recomputes cached game data every frame instead of once. Slower - leave off unless you are editing the plugin's static catalogs.
guide.none: This zone has no guide yet.
config.zoneInactive: You are not in this zone right now.
config.useMount: Summon a mount for long routes
config.useMountHint: Uses Mount Roulette when the destination is far. vnavmesh does not do this itself, so Hornwatch summons the mount.
config.dependencyVnavmesh: Required. Does the actual pathfinding and walking. Without it there is no auto-travel at all.
config.dependencyMissing: Missing - click to open the plugin installer
config.dependencyBlocked: Auto-travel is unavailable until vnavmesh is installed.
config.dependencyWalkOnly: Without Lifestream, travel walks the whole way - which is a long way in these zones.
nav.reason.lifestreamMissing: Teleporting needs the Lifestream plugin, which is not installed. Travel still works, it just walks the whole way.
config.useTeleport: Teleport to the nearest point first
config.useTeleportHint: Uses Lifestream to reach the zone teleport point closest to the destination, then walks the rest. Skipped when you already stand closer to the destination than that point does.
config.useReturn: Cast Return to reach the aethernet
config.useReturnHint: The aethernet can only be used while standing at one of its points. When none is within walking distance, Return becomes Occult Return and sends you to the base camp, which is one. It is a 3s cast that breaks on damage, so it is retried; if it cannot be cast at all, travel simply walks instead.
config.dependencyLifestream: Required for teleporting. Occult Crescent's teleport points are a custom aethernet, and Lifestream is what reaches them. Without it, auto-travel still runs but walks the entire way.
config.mountRouletteHint: Summons a random mount, the same as the in-game roulette.
config.mountSpecificHint: Always summons this mount. If it turns out not to be unlocked on this character, the roulette is used instead.
watch.respawnUnknown: Next pot unknown - no pot has ended in front of you since you entered the zone.
treasure.noData: This zone has no treasure data.
treasure.routeUndergroundHint: Off by default. The cave is dangerous to walk unattended, so the route stays on the surface and skips those coffers.
treasure.showOverlay: Show the toggle strip on the map
treasure.showMinimap: Show the markers on the minimap too
treasure.showMinimapHint: Only the ones on your current level, within 200 yalms. The game clamps distant markers to the edge, so a wider range would ring the minimap with icons.
treasure.showOverlayHint: The button column on the map's right edge. Hides the strip, not the markers.
treasure.alertsHint: Announces a coffer when you come within range of it.
treasure.flag: Place a map flag on it
treasure.flagHint: Without opening the map. Clicking the chat line does the same.
treasure.forgetHint: Out of sight longer than this, a coffer counts as new and is announced again.
bar.tooltip: Time to the next treasure pot. Click to open the watch list.
config.openOnEntry: Open the window when I enter the zone
config.openOnEntryHint: South Horn and North Horn only. It does not close on the way out.
config.keepOpenOnEscape: Do not let Escape close the window
config.keepOpenOnEscapeHint: The title bar cross and /hornwatch still close it.
config.showPotBar: Show the pot countdown in the server info bar
config.showPotBarHint: The strip next to the clock. Clicking it opens this plugin on the watch list.
config.showRouteOverlay: Draw the route in the world
config.showRouteOverlayHint: An arrow to the leg being walked, a ring on the final destination with the current phase and distance, and the next coffers numbered in order. For checking where travel is actually heading.
treasure.routeSighted: Only coffers I can actually see
treasure.routeSightedHint: Plans over the coffers standing in the world right now instead of all 62 spawn points, most of which are empty. Falls back to the full list when none are in sight.
treasure.routeSweepHint: Automation: needs auto-travel enabled. Fires the ability on its cooldown so coffers keep being detected along the way.
treasure.routeReturn: Return to camp when the route is finished
treasure.routeHostileHint: Off by default. Those areas killed an unattended run; leave this on only while you are watching.
